_help: Act 2, the military club: recruiting Tom Hargreaves (hired_hargreaves). 60, or 30 now and 30 owed (owe_hargreaves). His question about leaving the wounded sets his trust. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: hargreaves
already.line: Rifles cleaned, boots polished. Say the word.

first.speaker: hargreaves
first.line: Well, I'll be. Last time I saw you, you were walking out of a burning supply depot like you'd forgotten your hat. Heard you'd gone private.

menu.speaker: hargreaves
menu.line: What brings you to this den of old soldiers?

choices.label: Offer him the job
choices.line: I'm leading an expedition into the desert, Tom. I need someone who can keep people alive.

choices.label: Catch up
choices.line: What are you doing these days?

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Just passing through. Good to see you, Tom.

catchup.speaker: hargreaves
catchup.line: Security contracts. Warehouses, mostly. Guarding crates for men who'd sell their own mothers. It pays. It isn't much of a life.

question.speaker: hargreaves
question.line: Before I say yes, one question. If it goes bad out there, and someone's hurt and can't walk, what do you do?

choices.label: Carry them
choices.line: We carry them. Nobody gets left behind.

choices.label: Leave them, if I must
choices.line: If it's them or everyone, I leave them.

q_right.speaker: hargreaves
q_right.line: Right answer. I followed the other kind of officer once.

q_wrong.speaker: hargreaves
q_wrong.line: I've heard that before. I obeyed it, once. I won't again, and you'd best remember that.

fee.speaker: hargreaves
fee.line: Sixty pounds. I'm not cheap, and I'm not sorry.

choices.label: Half now, half later
choices.line: Thirty now, thirty when we're home.

joined.speaker: hargreaves
joined.line: Then I'm your man. I'll want to see every rifle before we leave.

joined_owed.speaker: hargreaves
joined_owed.line: Your word's good with me. Don't make me regret it.

too_rich.speaker: hargreaves
too_rich.line: Door's always open. Bar's always open, come to that.
